name: PokeRogue Vita
author: krappaU
description:
Play PokeRogue on your Vita. An unofficial client that runs the live pokerogue.net game, the same version as in a browser: it updates whenever the game does, and you log in with your PokeRogue account on the built-in keyboard and play on your cloud saves.

There is also an offline mode. The start screen downloads the offline build used by Admiral-Billy's PokeRogue App (about 530 MB) and plays it from the memory card, with local saves and no account, and offers updates when a new build is out.

The Vita's own browser can't run the game, so the app is a small purpose-built one: the QuickJS-ng JavaScript engine plus the web APIs PokeRogue uses, with WebGL on vitaGL and the heaviest rendering done natively. Music, sound effects and cries, the buttons as a gamepad and the front touchscreen all work. Saves can be exported to and imported from ux0:data/pokerogue/exports/, and links in the game's menus are shown as QR codes to open on a phone.

Beta: battles run at about 20-35 fps depending on the map, with occasional short pauses, and performance is still being improved. Online play needs Wi-Fi.
